In April of the third year of Chuping, a full year has passed since the alliance against Dong fell apart due to internal reasons, and the intestinal belly fat Dong Taishi early solid re-emergence, the fish and meat people, the extreme arrogance and luxury of that set of the original from a fire burned to ruins in Luoyang to the forced relocation of the new capital.
Despite the one-dimensional perverse, brutalizing the loyal, he is extremely cherish their own lives, but also know that want to take off his head of countless people, but all travel have to call on the martial arts when the world's unrivaled son Lu Bu, but also to the official title of the gold and silver ponies and treasures as a lure, only really rest assured down.
But never thought, just added to the tiger has not yet had time to shine a bit, will have to spend the day at his side as an inconspicuous guard, the heart is how suffocating.
Dong Taishi can't learn to use this set, on the one hand, he has to rely on the force of the righteous son, on the one hand, but also difficult to forget the righteous son's former father is how the tragic death, plus they are violent temper, a word Dong Zhuo on the angry throwing hand halberd, at the point of no harmony.
Yesterday, Dong Zhuo and because of the jade seal of the state fell into the hands of the lords of the news of the heart of the restlessness, to only know the stifled silence, set up a stink face of the righteous son of nature is no good face, but also to take some of the trivial things to do as a pretext for a hard attack on him a number of times.
Lu Bu's heart was really angry, so today he claimed to be sick and stayed in his own mansion, and he didn't want to call his wife and concubines to accompany him, so he drank alone to kill his sorrows. However, after three cups of wine, he became even more angry and threw the bottle to the ground: "Do I, Lu Fengxian, only deserve to drink this water! Bring me some good wine!"
He was famous for his divine bravery, he was also strong and powerful looking, and his voice was extremely loud, and this furious shout made the subordinates tremble, and they didn't even dare to clean up the wreckage of the wine bottles and wine, and they busily answered the voice and went to the cellar to fetch the wine.
Only what the annoyed Lu Bu waited for was not good wine, but the stuffy subordinate Gao Shun who pushed in the door.
"General." Gao Shun arched his hand, "There is a ......" he deliberated slightly, not knowing how to describe it "literati from Chang Ban Po, Yan Qing Yan Chongguang seeks an audience."
To those old pikers with no hands and only a rotten tongue to quote scripture and scold him, Lu Bu did not hesitate to reject: "No!"
Gao Shun was a little hesitant.
Of course he disliked those who only play smart, with a torrent of insults to the general to show their own chastity to defend the Han, but entrusted to him the literati look just past the age of the word table, but the temperament and appearance is extremely extraordinary, but also rare willingness to release the goodwill, for the general under the command of the scarcity of think tanks, a little to see one side is certainly not a bad thing. He then didn't give up immediately, but tried to persuade, ''He specially brought a jar of homemade spirits, saying that it's a meeting gift. From what I see, this person's words are earnest, so it would be good to meet him."
It's not the first time that a literati asked to see himself, but it's rare that he brings a gift that suits him, and it's a plea to the loyal vice general under his tent, Lu Bu hummed in an uncertain manner, "Where's the wine? Bring it."
Gao Shun was carrying it in his hand and offered it immediately.
As soon as the lid was removed, the rich and mellow aroma of the wine instantly hit his nose, Lu Bu's mood instantly improved a lot - not all because of this smell is the reason for good wine, but even if they are again by those who pretend to be high and mighty, but there are also occasional knowingly interested in it?
"Let him come in." Lu Bu couldn't help but pour a cup on the spot and sniffed it carefully, his eyes flashed with light, and he suddenly changed his mind and called out to Gao Shun, who was about to go out in response to his voice: "That's just it, I'll go and take a look myself."
As long as you are in a high position and hold a lot of power, even if you are notorious, there will never be a shortage of people who either flatter or make false pretenses. What's more, anyone with a clear eye can see how much Master Dong valued the world's unrivaled martial artist, which is why the residence of this lieutenant general has always been known as a marketplace, but Lu Bu was impatient to pick and choose from the mixed bag of applicants.
This Yan Chongguang who came from afar has a few skills, and got Gao Shun's eyes, and did not have to wait like others in the crowded and bustling place, but was led by the maid to a quiet and tidy side hall to wait, and poured a cup of tea for him to sip slowly and leisurely.
When Lu Bu who followed Gao Shun behind stepped into the threshold, the scholar with his hands behind his back happened to turn around at the sound of his voice, and at this glance, even Lu Bu, who has always had his eyes on the top, and cannot help but be brightened up by ordinary people.
The end is like a jade face, eyes like a bit of lacquer, body long jade standing, the temperament is outstanding. The only thing that can be called a deficiency in beauty is that this excellent face is too biased in favor of androgynous beauty.
But only Yan Qing himself knows, his own this pair of beautiful and feminine over the top appearance is entirely thanks to that before crossing the Three Kingdoms to play the hero - Diao Cicada gift, if not this body of white uncharacteristically tender flesh at least with a handle, he died on the spot to try to see if you can wear back to the heart all have.
After finishing a cup of tea, he calmly ignored the furtive glances cast by the maids of honor, pondering whether to stay a little longer with a thick skin so as not to waste Lord Gao Shun's other eyes, or to have the sense to leave for the time being and come back to try again at another time, when he heard the crowd's sonorous footsteps.
He pressed down the sudden surge of excitement, hardened his composure and waited a little before getting up to welcome, but in his heart he was surprised that the other party would come so soon.
From the twenty-first century, he naturally knew that Lu Bu was heavy in courage and light in talent, and was not at all a courteous master. His own young age is not half famous, but also the identity of the literati, but also very miserable looks like a sissy, how to look at the other side of the difficult to treat - can be referred to the resourceful but always not trusted and valued Chen Gongtai's treatment.
However, even with all the concerns, Yan Qing really couldn't resist the proud elegance of this battle-hardened and deservedly the No. 1 fierce general of the Three Kingdoms, and resolved to at least make an effort to try to help him get rid of the tragic ending by using the convenience of his own at least remembering some of the history.
Especially led to the great pride of the general had to lead the remnants of the army fled in a mess, wandering around a big obstacle is close at hand: that is the Situ Wang Yun and his daughter Diao Chan against the two appearance of the God and the righteous father and son set up, the famous beauty of the chain of tricks.
The man was met with unexpected smoothness, what would it take to get him to listen to his words, or even to agree with the ploy.
"I am from Chang Ban Po, Yan Qing, character Chong Guang, I have long heard of General Lu's great name, thank you for receiving me."
Yan Qing first raised his head and quickly took a head-to-toe look at this shrewd and sturdy, tall and brawny, with a length of nearly a foot, standing in front of him who was now no more than just a meter and seven-odd feet tall, as if he were mortared against a high wall, but who was to become his future lord without any surprises, Lv Fengxian, who was to be his future lord, and then he saluted without any panic.
Lu Bu narrowed his fine jeweled eyes slightly and sized him up carefully as well before slowly asking, "What are you here for?"
Yan Qing frankly accepted the First Fierce General's scrutiny. In fact, he liked this kind of openness, after all, if he were to interrogate in detail, his own fabricated life would not stand up to scrutiny, and immediately reported the same cheerfulness, "Qing has traveled a long way here, only to seek a bright master."
Lu Bu lazily didn't pick up on it or make a statement, "Oh?"
Yan Qing could not see Lu Bu's attitude, but according to his analysis, the historical trajectory of the chief strategist Chen Gong has not yet turned his back on Cao Cao, naturally did not switch to Lu Bu's command, then at this time their own appearance, should also be able to take advantage of the timing, so did not panic - in front of Lu Bu dare to show panic at this time I'm afraid that not far away from death! --He only smiled faintly, and this time he changed his bow: "This bright master is far away from the sky, but close to my eyes. If General Lu doesn't mind, I would like to honor you as my master, serve you as a dog and horse, and do my best to advise you."
His looks were already outstanding, and his smile was even more pleasing to the eyes. Lu Bu, however, stared at him with an inscrutable face for a while, noncommittally hummed lightly, and resolutely turned around and walked away.
Hula took away all the general's entourage that followed him, windy as when he came, leaving only a tiger-headed Gao Shun.
Yan Qing's light smile froze on his face, "......"
And so on.
So?
Even in the worst case scenario, such as Lu Bu suddenly taking offense at his girlish appearance and having to rise up and slash him a few times, he would be able to daintily fling out the four flashes in his pocket to fight off a wave of outbursts, and then dash out of the door at speed to get on the horse parked outside to escape, but this reaction-
While he was stumped, Gao Shun laughed and took the initiative to come forward, patting him on the shoulder affectionately and clearing up his confusion, "Mr. Yan Qing, I am Gao Shun Gao Fuyi of the Trapped Battalion, and in the future, we will be fellow soldiers."
Yan Qing's spirit was buoyant, and he gratefully returned a big salute to this loyal general who had sworn allegiance to Lu Bu: "Thanks to General Gao for introducing me to the Lord, since I have the honor of being a fellow officer, please also call Qing watchword just fine."
Gao Shun saw that he did not look like those civil officials who were pedantic about rituals and laws that the Lord occasionally dealt with on weekdays, and felt even more that he fit the temperament of a martial artist, and exclaimed with a smile, "I really didn't look away!"
They were happily feeling what it meant to be like at first sight, and were about to chat some more, when the attendant suddenly came to report, "General Gao, Lord Situ has sent someone to see him."
Gao Shun could only apologize, "I'll have to excuse myself for a moment." But before a moment had passed, he cursed himself, "It's me who's confused, what's there for mister to avoid? Isn't this exactly the time when sir is needed!"
Yan Qing could not help but smile, and without excusing himself, he readily agreed to go with Gao Shun.
One is to perform well and prove that his ability is worthy of staying, and the second is ...... Wang Yun came really fast, so I don t know whether the next move to make is the one in the playbook or the one in the Three Kingdoms.

The attendant sent by Situ Wang Yun to seek an audience only conveyed one meaning, that is, tomorrow he will host a banquet at his residence in the hope of inviting the magnificent and courageous Lord Lieutenant General, so that he will also be deeply honored and have a good face.
Just as the playbook says, Lord Situ's carefully planned trap has already unfolded, and Lu Bu's good play of Diaochan is about to be staged.
I have to say, in the brutal and tyrannical Dong Zhuo can be mixed under the Wang Yun, absolutely can afford to be able to bend and stretch the praise. He had the intention to pat himself on the back, and although Lu Bu scoffed, after listening to the relay, in the end he allowed it, "Go back! Inform Lord Situ that I will be there."
As soon as the attendant left, Yan Qing pressed down on his small, ulterior excitement, swept the surrounding area with a faint expression, and said in a steady voice, "My Lord, may I be heard to ask three questions?"
Lu Bu looked at him with an expressionless face, and then whirled around, dismissing his left and right, leaving only one Gao Shun behind, "Ask."
Yan Qingxian said, "Does the Lord know what the purpose of Lord Situ's invitation is?"
Without thinking, Lu Bu said, "I don't know."
Yan Qing: "......"
The man seems a bit keen to go off the beaten track, can't we just let him pretend in its entirety?
Lu Bu grunted and laughed, "We'll see if we go."
Yan Qing was helpless, he didn't know whether Lu Bu was emboldened, really didn't care about Wang Yun's scheming, or was purely trying to play with himself, "Then the Lord thinks that the one who can make Lord Situ throw up his heart and soul and swear to support him is the son of the Han Dynasty, or ...... "
He didn't need to finish his question, Lu Bu would naturally know which power he was referring to, and coldly grunted, "Naturally, it's the current saint."
Yan Qing finally said, "My lord is wise. However, with your help, the already powerful Lord Taishi is even more powerful, so according to what you think, will Lord Situ be happy to see you close to him and in harmony?"
Lu Bu's eyes rolled slightly and he didn't pick up on it.
Yan Qing saw the good to end, a light smile back to the seat, sip the cold wine: he does not expect difficult to listen to the advice of Lu Fengxian will completely believe him, but first planted a seed of wariness, the original suspicion to the loyal Gao Shun do not fully believe Lu Bu will not be because of the compulsion to listen to the overflowing words of Wang Yun, wrongly regarded the other party as a person can be pushed to put his heart.
Yan Qing's purpose is not to make Lu Bu dead heartedly continue to protect that their own death sooner or later dog with the Dong Taishi, on the contrary, in his plan, in the eyes of the world, the death of the villain Dong Zhuo must die, and the same is dead under the halberd of Lu Bu, but should not be because of the beauty, and even can not waste this great opportunity to turn passive into active in public to ask for help to kill the thieves, and together to get a The name of "righteousness" completely whitewash, jump out of this fire pit before the next action.
However, all of this is still on the level of paper, before he can really plan all of this, he still has to go along with it and borrow the plans of Wang Yun and his adopted daughter Diaochan to properly stimulate Lu Bu's rebel heart before he can do so.
Moreover, as long as the control is appropriate, the beauty will not be able to scourge the heroes who have lost their minds, so they can only be a vase of beautiful concubines, playing the role of eye candy and boredom.
As Yan Qing absentmindedly finished his third sip of wine and Lu Bu's arguably lengthy contemplation came to an end, he raised his jaw and couldn't help but stare at the face that appeared even more exquisite and stunning under the jumping candlelight, drifting off for a few moments before saying, "In your opinion?"
Yan Qing does not sell: "Wine after three rounds, Lord Situ most likely will first open the mouth to test the attitude of the Lord, the Lord can push the boat to sell a few points of dissatisfaction with the master to him. By virtue of his deep heart, immediately after and will not disclose this, more will not be shallow to provoke a few sentences to scare snakes, but will therefore slacken vigilance, rest assured that the poisonous bait to feed."
Lu Bu paused and repeated heavily, "Poison bait?"
Yan Qing laughed, can't help but bring out a few points of cunning to: "Beauty country hero mound, congratulations to the Lord, if the Qing is not wrong, Lord Situ dating will be the national color of the daughter of the gift, then you can laugh, we will know what tricks he is going to offer."
The corner of Lu Bu's lips revealed a mocking arc, not directed at Yan Qing who had uttered these words, but after a moment's thought, he ordered concisely and forcefully, "In order to confirm that what you say is not true, you will go with me to the banquet tomorrow."
That's a real surprise!
The thought of meeting Diao Chan, who is known as "Closed Moon", and watching her seducing Lu Bu from a close distance, even if both parties are in the dark hostile position of utilizing each other, makes Yan Qing feel excited and expectant, but fortunately, he has practiced the art of keeping his joy and anger out of his eyes, and only arched his hand with no fear of being spoiled or humiliated: "Qing obeyed."
Lu Bu impatiently waved his hand and kicked him out along with Gao Shun.
The next day to go to the banquet, Lu Bu is naturally impatient to ride in the carriage, mounted on the tiger red rabbit horse, followed by a vast number of murderous generals, was about to set off, suddenly remembered that this time also brought a weak scribe.
He turned back to see Yan Qing, whose face was so beautiful that she couldn't help but draw sidelong glances from even the strictly disciplined ranks of the army, but who had no self-consciousness whatsoever, dressed in a flowing green shirt, walking with a flourish to a majestic and extraordinary high horse and tilting her head to look at it for a moment.
In a group of big and thick soldiers, the gentle and elegant man would look out of place.
Lu Bu draws the corner of his mouth, ready to order his subordinates to prepare a carriage for him, when he sees Yan Qing smilingly patting the head of that humming and panting child, the horse that originally appeared to be annoyed by the proximity of the living people quietly lowers its head, obediently letting him press it, and dashingly rolls over and mounts up, but he takes out the skill of the world's family's disciples who are good at horseback riding and archery, and steadily mounts up.
"What are you still standing there for?" Seeing that he had the ability to fend for himself, Lu Bu twisted his head to stop looking, patted his horse's neck, and droned, "Depart!"
After crossing over, the physique was altered in many ways, for example, riding and shooting became an instinct, and thanks to this blessing, Yan Qing easily saved his face.
He rode his horse with ease, taking advantage of his position with disinterest to survey the fact that in front of him was Lord Bongseon, whose back was as sharp and fierce as a sheathed sword blade.
A black armor light look are heavy tight, black hair bundled, bright red helmet tassel towering a section, and because of inertia down, with the red rabbit's gallant steps upside down, like two thick cockroach whiskers, as well as two red pigtails, attracted Yan Qing can not help but to stare at the look.
The more the line, the more he found himself in this line of people caused passers-by vendors scrambling to avoid, panicked and afraid to look at the situation is not like an invitation to a banquet, but more like a war to seek revenge to go.
It seems that as the number one henchman of the infamous Master Dong, the even more vicious Lu Fengxian is the god of killing who makes children stop crying, and his reputation has also fallen into the gutter.
A heavy task and a long way to go, even though he had been psychologically prepared for this, Yan Qing still couldn't help but sigh despondently.
However, Situ Wang Yun has been used to this, in order to show solemnity and sincerity, he even personally stood to the door to meet. Seeing the arrogant and domineering Zhonglang General's favorite horse Red Hare like a small mountain, provocatively almost sticking to his face brake, tired of eating a lot of dust lifted up, but also not shocked by the change, just a smile: "General Lu's arrival, so that a certain person deeply fluffy ah! Quickly please come in!"
This endurance of humiliation was in stark contrast to the tyrannical Zhonglang General, and not only did it fall into the eyes of the outraged populace and the servants of the Wang family, but it was also captured by Yan Qing.
Lu Bu smiled condescendingly before dismounting, tossing the reins into his personal attendant's hand and striding in, "Lord Situ, how are you doing?"
The rest of his entourage consciously stayed outside, with only Yan Qing following.
Wang Yun turned his gaze to Yan Qing in dismay, and all of a sudden his eyes were shaken by his dignified and peerless face, while his words were directed at Lu Bu, "General Lu, this ......"
As if Lu Bu didn't hear his refusal and difficulty at all, he said graciously, "Oh! This is my general's staff Yan Chongguang, just bringing him to see the world, Lord Situ won't be stingy to give him a seat, right?"
This is obviously out of Wang Yun's plan, but Lu Bu's natural tone of voice does not allow for any room for debate, although the shiny square sky painted halberd is quiet, but invariably helps the master's aggressiveness. He quickly gathered his emotions and greeted Yan Qing with a polite smile, "So it's Mr. Shiguang! Please come inside."
"Pleased to meet you, Lord Situ." Yan Qing smiled and returned the salute, not entangling with Situ who condescended to want to make false pretenses with himself, and straightly followed the striding Lu Bu, also playing up the point of the fox pretending to be a tiger to the fullest.
Despite the fact that Yan Qing, an uninvited guest, was killed in the middle of the road, Wang Yun did not give up his intention to implement the plan. With the beautiful food and wine like flowing water on the table, a few rounds of intentional exchange of cups, not able to win the scribe will be prone on the wine table, unconscious.
Wang Yun also drank red, see the situation know that the time has come, and only drink wine, rarely speak Lu Bu exclaimed, "Tie, Lu general recently why closed the door?"
Lu Bu's movements lagged, and without a trace, he swept his eyes at the drunken Yan Qing and said viciously, "Since my righteous father is in a bad mood, why should I make a fool of myself?"
Again, under the guidance of Wang Yun, he gave and told the scolding he received for no reason.
Wang Yun frowned: "This is actually the case! If General Lu is not a foolish and filial person, would you be willing to listen to Yun's advice?"
Lu Bu's eyes skimmed over an oddity extremely quickly, but his mouth only said impatiently, "Speak!"
Wang Yun will be impassioned to say the classic lines that make the pretend drunk Yan Qing almost can not strain his face: "Jun since the surname Lu, this is not flesh and blood. Now worry about death is not time, what is father and son? Throwing the halberd, there is no father and son love evil!"
Lu Bu appropriately re-smashed his wine bottle and grimly responded, "What Lord Situ said is very true!"
It was one of his favorite bottles!
Wang Yun's heart ached so much that his eyelids fluttered.
Can hibernate under Dong Zhuo unharmed for many years, he is not the generation of quick success, although provoked the tiger's anger, but did not add a handful of oil, but a turn of phrase: "Yun has a small daughter, can sing and dance, general would like me to introduce you?"
"Okay!" Lu Bu was still disillusioned, but he just didn't want to brush off the good intentions of Wang Yun, who had enlightened him just now, so he reluctantly agreed.
Wang Yun called Diaochan in the head, but did not notice, Lu Bu's eyes fluttered for a moment, and could not help but glance again since the banquet opened soon after pretending to sleep lazy strategist Yan Qing a glance - actually really by him repeatedly said.

"Call my son!"
Wang Yun gave an order, and the famous closed-moon Sable Cicada in history came in style with two green-clothed maids leading the way.
She was born with a flowery face, this time after careful preparations, dress under the makeup is too beautiful to look at, slender and delicate posture, waist is not a handful of limbs, not like an ordinary woman to see a proud and brave tiger generals show timidity, but not humble and not supercilious, leisurely down to worship.
"Oh."
However, with the shock given by Yan Qing, whose appearance is so outstanding that it amazes the world, Lu Bu just glanced at her calmly and quietly to appreciate Diao Chan, who is heavily made up and is in a nest with the malicious Wang Yun.
He also immediately looked at Yan Qing in the side seat.
As expected, this pretending to be drunk to avoid laziness of the bold strategist saw a good show to be staged, naturally do not want to miss, while no one to take his attention, that crooked leaning posture do not know when to subtly change the direction of the drunken face coincidentally rushed to the upper seat. The light in the hall is already dim, he only need to quietly raise his eyes, in the case of no one knows, the Lord for the corner of the play to see a clear.
Lu Bu narrowed his eyes slightly and grinded his teeth in a fury.
This kid, even if he really has a few clever skills, specially brought him here, and really made himself a monkey show for him to see?
Wang Yun, who knows nothing about this, smiled and said, "This is the daughter of Diaochan, the art is excellent. If the general does not give up, allow her to dance on a song, this feast to help cheer up can be good?"
Lu Bu shifted his gaze back to meet the shy and curious eyes of this girl with colorful makeup, seriously and revealingly sized her up, and sincerely praised her, ''Oh? She is actually Lord Situ's favorite daughter! His Excellency has given birth to an extremely beautiful daughter."
Wang Yun was solidly choked a bit, if not know that this reckless not how to pass the ink, he will think that the other side is deliberately sarcastic his honor: "General joking. Although she is not my bloodline, but I pity her appearance, but also love her talent, since the shelter to the house since it is like a daughter raised."
Lu Bu came to a realization, "If Your Excellency has such a good intention, Bu will accept the honor."
Wang Yun secretly wiped the sweat, really do not want to cause further trouble, and hurriedly let Diaochan lead the dance.
Only the melodious music had just been played, and the cloud sleeves of the beauty in the pool had not yet fluttered, Lu Bu suddenly drank for no reason: "Wait!"
This male voice when it is a strong and powerful, visible master how much blood exuberant, is like a clear sky splitting down the loud thunder, just happened to rush in the real civil officials, Situ Wang Yun ear blasted open.
Diaochan okay, just do not know what to do froze on the spot, and the implementation of the plan of Wang Yun was nervous, after this shock, almost out of order to shriek out, nearly stabilized, forced to suppress anger and asked: "May I ask the general, what's wrong?"
Yan Qing had a sudden bad feeling.
This premonition was soon fulfilled, only to hear Lu Bu pat his knee in chagrin and say, "Lord Situ doesn't know, this strategist of Bu's body is weak, letting him lie down on the seat after drinking is not a good idea at all."
Wang Yun forced a smile and said dryly, "Since this is the case Lord General's compassion for his subordinates, Yun will send someone to take Mr. Yan down to rest."
Lu Bu rejoiced, "This couldn't be better!"
This is not what was planned wow!
Seeing that she was about to be forcibly removed from the table, Yan Qing could no longer pretend, and had to wake up by rubbing her brow extremely coincidentally as she was carefully attempted to be moved by the maids.
After meeting his lord's gloating gaze, Yan Qing seemed to be in a daze for a while before snapping out of it, bowing repeatedly and saying guiltily, "It's all because of Qing's momentary greed for a glass, but he was out of sorts to such an extent that he still begs for his lord's forgiveness and Lord Situ's apology."
Lu Bu said with concern, "Sir, don't force yourself, it's better to go to a ventilated place to rest a little."
However, Yan Qing was extremely thick-skinned, and not only did he ignore this, but also righteously said, "Lord is still in the chair, how can I be so honorable as to withdraw first? Qing again cheeky, also should not be contented to accept this good intentions, please do not delay in the body of the Qing effort."
Lu Bu's thin lips lifted and said with a leathery smile, "Alright!" Then he apologized to the stone-faced Wang Yun, "I'm really sorry for keeping your lordship waiting."
This is okay, but his look is full of perfunctory, clearly does not see himself in the eyes. Spare Wang Yun stoicism enough, also slowed down for a moment before laughing out: "How could, Fengxian general eyes heavy."
And hastily rushed to be cold for a long time Sable Cicada made a wink, finally let this twist and turn of the song and dance act down.
Diao Chan slightly held her head, not angry and not annoyed to respond. Yan Qing is also blessed by the misfortune, do not have to sneak, can be openly ornamental beauty that looks like a layer of clouds like scrolling colorful sleeves, the stunning dance just outlined the waist of the slender curls, foggy eyebrows without waiting to see clearly, after the pressure waist is presented in the bright face is a flood of water, shyly to the seat of the hero's dark eyes.
This is a very interesting picture, and it also fits with the author's description of "After the dance, I stole my eyes through the curtains, not knowing who is the King of Xiang of Chu".
The first beauty of the Three Kingdoms is indeed true to its name, this Diaochan waist thin foot slender, but a chest has a gully of strange women, obviously counting on the violent temper of Lu Fengxian, the eyes of love but can not see half false, but let a person's face red heartbeat of the pulse of the love, no wonder that let the read through the beauty of Dong Zhuo's father and son are difficult to escape a robbery.
As Yan Qing watched with great interest, he couldn't help but incidentally steal a glance at the rightful owner who was being painstakingly seduced by the beauty, but the result of this glance was that it knuckled him down and horrified him - not only was General Lu Fengxian not looking entranced and mesmerized, but he had also been staring at himself with a profound and inscrutable gaze since who knows when.
Seeing Yan Qing notice, Lu Bu seemed to snort in disdain and moved his eyes back to Diaochan.
I don't know what I did to upset him, about not being allowed to covet his favorite concubines?
Thinking of this, Yan Qing heart a flinch, the Lord's heart of mind was originally small, he has not been reused, and how to withstand unwarranted suspicion? Rush to sit upright, look at the flower-like jade dance girl also convergence quite a lot.
When Diao Chan finished her dance, she retreated to her foster father's side like a weak willow, but her shy eyes still couldn't help but look at the imposing general.
Lu Bu a pair of shining tiger eyes also hot after her, see her shy nodding, pursed lips, is precisely the love of concubines. Seeing this scene, Wang Yun was overjoyed, not to mention the anxious Lu Bu took the initiative to propose marriage next: "The dance is really beautiful, the person is even more beautiful! I don't know if you have ever promised such a beauty to anyone?"
Wang Yun stroked his palm and laughed loudly, "That's exactly what I want! As the saying goes, a beauty matches a hero, my daughter, regardless of anything else, has excellent color and skill, and is fortunate to be able to become a concubine and serve at the side of General Lu, whose martial arts and bravery are well known throughout the world, which is a match made in heaven, and is also a blessing that she has cultivated in her past life."
Yan Qing appropriately plays the role of an uneducated dog's leg, and repeatedly expresses his joy, "Congratulations, my lord, on your joyous acquisition of a beautiful woman. Just Lord Situ, I wonder when our general will be able to marry Miss Diaochan?"
Wang Yun touched the dry and thin beard, smilingly said, "also please wait for me to choose a good day, and then for my daughter to prepare a good dowry, will naturally be sent to the general's residence, please wait a little while for the general to wait for the good news."
When he was out of Wang Situ's gate, Lu Bu abruptly withdrew the smile on his face and coldly drank, "Go back to the house!"
Yan Qing was originally pretending to be drunk, by this night's icy cold wind, even if there is really drunkenness, but also dissipated almost, sniffing energetically on the horse, followed closely behind.
